37563-a-man-of-honor.creator: Unknown
37563-a-man-of-honor.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Robert Pagebrook was "blue." 6806-the-hallam-succession.creator: Unknown
6806-the-hallam-succession.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. English home--fine old halls and granges, set in wooded parks, and surrounded by sweet, shady gardens. One of the fairest of these homes is Hallam-Croft. There may be larger halls in the West Riding, but none that combines so finely all the charms of antiquity, with every modern grace and comfort.

arxiv-2102-10321.title: Design of Ciphers based on the Geometric Structure of the Möbius Plane
arxiv-2102-10321.creator: Christoph Capellaro
arxiv-2102-10321.description: Abstract Till now geometric structures don’t play a major role in cryptography. Gilbert, MacWilliams and Sloane [ GMS74 ] introduced an authentication scheme in the projective plane and showed its perfectness in the sense of Shannon [ Sha49 ] .

arxiv-2107-04721.title: U-Net with Hierarchical Bottleneck Attention for Landmark Detection in Fundus Images of the Degenerated Retina
arxiv-2107-04721.creator: Shuyun Tang, Ziming Qi, Jacob Granley, Michael Beyeler
arxiv-2107-04721.description: Abstract Fundus photography has routinely been used to document the presence and severity of retinal degenerative diseases such as age-related macular degeneration (AMD) , glaucoma, and diabetic retinopathy (DR) in clinical practice, for which the fovea and optic disc (OD) are important retinal landmarks.

arxiv-2305-15965.title: Topological-Holomorphic
arxiv-2305-15965.creator: 𝒩
arxiv-2305-15965.description:
A 2023 arXiv research paper by 𝒩. Abstract

We perform a topological-holomorphic twist of
\mathcal{N}=4
supersymmetric gauge theory on a four-manifold of the form
M_{4}=\Sigma_{1}\times\Sigma_{2}
with Riemann surfaces
\Sigma_{1,2}
, and unravel the mathematical implications of its physics. In particular, we consider different linear combinations of the resulting scalar supercharges under
S
-duality, where this will allow us to derive novel topological and holomorphic invariants of
M_{4}
and their Langlands duals.

arxiv-2306-04638.title: Sun’s Series via Cyclotomic Multiple Zeta Values This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Asymptotics and Applications of Special Functions in Memory of Richard Paris. The full collection is available at https://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/Paris.html
arxiv-2306-04638.creator: Yajun ZHOU ab
arxiv-2306-04638.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yajun ZHOU ab. We prove and generalize several recent conjectures of Z.-W. Sun surrounding binomial coefficients and harmonic numbers. We show that Sun’s series and their analogs can be represented as cyclotomic multiple zeta values of levels N ∈ { 4 , 8 , 12 , 16 , 24 } N\in\{4,8,12,16,24\} , namely Goncharov’s multiple polylogarithms evaluated at N N -th roots of unity.

arxiv-2306-09112.creator: Bastian Boll, Christoph Schnörr

In structured prediction, target objects have rich internal structure which does not factorize into independent components and violates common i.i.d. assumptions. This challenge becomes apparent through the exponentially large output space in applications such as image segmentation or scene graph generation.

arxiv-2309-16296.title: Production properties of deuterons, helions and tritons via an analytical nucleon coalescence method in Pb-Pb collisions at s N ​ N = 2.76 \sqrt{s_{NN}}=2.76 TeV
arxiv-2309-16296.creator: Rui-Qin Wang, Yan-Hao Li, Jun Song, Feng-Lan Shao
arxiv-2309-16296.description: Abstract We improve a nucleon coalescence model to include the coordinate-momentum correlation in nucleon joint distributions, and apply it to Pb-Pb collisions at s N ​ N = 2.76 \sqrt{s_{NN}}=2.76 TeV to study production properties of deuterons ( d d ), helions ( 3 He) and tritons ( t t ).

arxiv-2404-19211.title: Triply efficient shadow tomography
arxiv-2404-19211.creator: Robbie King, David Gosset, Robin Kothari, Ryan Babbush
arxiv-2404-19211.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Robbie King, David Gosset, Robin Kothari, Ryan Babbush. Given copies of a quantum state ρ \rho , a shadow tomography protocol aims to learn all expectation values from a fixed set of observables, to within a given precision ϵ \epsilon . We say that a shadow tomography protocol is triply efficient if it is sample- and time-efficient, and only employs measurements that entangle a constant number of copies of ρ \rho at a time.

arxiv-2409-08894.title: Poisson brackets and coaction maps of regularized holonomies of the KZ equation
arxiv-2409-08894.creator: Anton Alekseev, Florian Naef, Muze Ren
arxiv-2409-08894.description: Abstract We derive explicit closed formulas for the Kirillov-Kostant-Souriau (KKS) coaction maps of open path regularized holonomies of the Knizhnik-Zamolodchikov (KZ) equation, and the corresponding Poisson brackets for the Lie algebra gl ⁡ ( N , ℂ ) {\rm gl}(N,\mathbb{C}) . Our main technical tool is a certain projection of the generalized pentagon equation of [ 3 ] .

arxiv-2412-18550.title: Fermion masses and mixings and charged lepton flavor violation in a 3-3-1 model with inverse seesaw
arxiv-2412-18550.creator: A. E. Cárcamo Hernández, D. T. Huong, H. N. Long, Daniel Salinas-Arizmendi
arxiv-2412-18550.description: Abstract We propose a 3-3-1 model augmented with A 4 A_{4} flavor symmetry to address fermion mass hierarchy, mixing patterns, and charged Lepton Flavor Violating (cLFV). The model incorporates an inverse seesaw mechanism to explain the small active neutrino masses through sterile neutrinos.

arxiv-2503-08105.title: Boundary values and zeros of Harmonic Product of Complex-valued Harmonic Functions in a simply connected bounded Domain
arxiv-2503-08105.creator: Ayantu Guteta Fite, Hunduma Legesse Geleta
arxiv-2503-08105.description: Abstract The product of two complex-valued harmonic function is not in general complex-valued harmonic function. In this paper we show that if a complex-valued harmonic function is the product of two complex-valued harmonic functions, then it is the difference of two squares, one is analytic and the other is co-analytic.

arxiv-2508-17573.title: Humanizing Machines: Rethinking LLM Anthropomorphism Through a Multi-Level Framework of Design
arxiv-2508-17573.creator: Yunze Xiao, Lynnette Hui Xian Ng, Jiarui Liu, Mona DiabCarnegie Mellon University {yunzex,huixiann,jiaruil5,mdiab}@andrew.cmu.edu
arxiv-2508-17573.description: Abstract Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly exhibit anthropomorphism characteristics – human-like qualities portrayed across their outlook, language, behavior, and reasoning functions. Such characteristics enable more intuitive and engaging human-AI interactions. However, current research on anthropomorphism remains predominantly risk-focused, emphasizing over-trust and user deception while offering limited design guidance.

arxiv-2509-02512.title: MoPEQ: Mixture of Mixed Precision Quantized Experts
arxiv-2509-02512.creator: Krishna Teja Chitty-Venkata, Jie Ye, Murali Emani
arxiv-2509-02512.description: Abstract Large Language and Vision Models using a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture pose significant challenges for deployment due to their computational and memory demands. Mixed Precision Quantization assigns different precisions to different layers of an LLM/VLM based on layer sensitivity and importance within the model.

arxiv-2602-08235.title: When Benign Inputs Lead to Severe Harms: Eliciting Unsafe Unintended Behaviors of Computer-Use Agents
arxiv-2602-08235.creator: Jaylen Jones, Zhehao Zhang, Yuting Ning, Eric Fosler-Lussier, Pierre-Luc St-Charles, Yoshua Bengio, Dawn Song, Yu Su, Huan Sun
arxiv-2602-08235.description: Abstract Although computer-use agents (CUAs) hold significant potential to automate increasingly complex OS workflows, they can demonstrate unsafe unintended behaviors that deviate from expected outcomes even under benign input contexts. However, exploration of this risk remains largely anecdotal, lacking concrete characterization and automated methods to proactively surface long-tail unintended behaviors under realistic CUA scenarios.

plos-pone-0001027.creator: Marta Szulkin, Ben C. Sheldon
plos-pone-0001027.description: PLOS ONE research article. Inbreeding depression occurs when the offspring produced as a result of matings between relatives show reduced fitness, and is generally understood as a consequence of the elevated expression of deleterious recessive alleles. How inbreeding depression varies across environments i

pmc-11404487.title: Accessible Double Nanohole Raman Tweezer Analysis of Single Nanoparticles
pmc-11404487.creator: Behnam Khosravi, Reuven Gordon
pmc-11404487.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Raman spectroscopy allows for material characterization of nanoparticles; however, probing individual nanoparticles requires an efficient way of isolating and enhancing the signal. Past works have used optical trapping with nanoapertures in metal films to measure the Raman spectra of individual nanoparticles; however, those works required custom laser tweezer systems that provided a transmission signal to verify trapping events as well as costly top-down nanofabrication.

pmc-12093570.title: Postoperative Rehabilitation of Elbow Pain
pmc-12093570.creator: Hyojune Kim, Kyoung Hwan Koh, In-Ho Jeon
pmc-12093570.description: The elbow joint, with its intricate anatomy, plays a pivotal role in the upper limb's functional movements. Common surgical indications include epicondylitis, osteoarthritis, tendon tears, and neuropathies. Irrespective of the nature of surgery, appropriate postoperative rehabilitation is essential to enhance recovery, optimize functional outcomes, and minimize complications. Protective measures for the elbow vary based on the surgical procedure is performed.

pmc-12473437.title: Neurotoxicological Evaluation of Intrathecal Citrate Excipients: Calcium Homeostasis Disruption and Safety Implications in CNS Drug Delivery
pmc-12473437.creator: Jue Wang, Yuan Zhang, Qing He, Ying Du, Xia Zhang, Xinru Tan, Xinting Zhou, Susu Tang, Baoming Ning, Rui Yang, Xia Zhao, Dejiang Tan, Huimin Sun, Jiasheng Tu, Carlotta Marianecci
pmc-12473437.description: Background/Objectives: Intrathecal drug delivery is essential for treating CNS disorders, but the safety of commonly used excipients such as citric acid/sodium citrate (SC) remains unclear. This study aims to systematically evaluate the potential neuropharmacological effects of repeated intrathecal SC administration. Methods: Multimodal approaches were applied across murine and lagomorph models. Doses ranged from 1.833–14.664 μg/g in mice and 0.104–3.290 mg/rabbit.

pmc-12772509.title: Vaccination of calves with Bacille Calmette Guerin increased the frequency but did not affect aggregation or clustering of natural killer cells in draining lymph nodes
pmc-12772509.creator: Jayne C Hope, Sarah Ho, Clara Zifko, Carly A Hamilton, Darren J Shaw
pmc-12772509.description: IntroductionNatural killer (NK) cells are central to innate immune responses but they also influence adaptive immunity. Evidence suggests that NK cells are involved in protective immune responses induced by the Bacille Calmette Guerin (BCG) vaccine. In cattle, vaccination with BCG provides significant protection against infection with Mycobacterium bovis, the causative agent of bovine tuberculosis (bTB).

pmc-13089011.title: Liver Ewing sarcoma: A case report
pmc-13089011.creator: Sarah Lembarki, Fatma ez zahrae El malki, Nazik Allali, Latifa Chat, Siham EL haddad, Zineb Isfaoun, Amina Kili, Maria El kababri, Laila Hesissen, M Ouchen, Mounir Kisra, S Sefiani
pmc-13089011.description: Ewing’s sarcoma (ES) is a rare malignant small round-cell tumor that usually arises in bone and only exceptionally originates in visceral organs. We report the case of a 7-year-old boy with primary hepatic ES, the youngest case described to date.

pmc-13130571.title: Neutrophil extracellular traps in the tumor microenvironment, metastasis, therapy, and beyond: advances, challenges, and perspectives
pmc-13130571.creator: Jingwen He, Zhaokai Zhou, Guangyang Cheng, Huabing Li, Jiaqi Tu, Zixuan Fan, Xiuting Qiu, Wenjie Chen, Yajun Chen, Ling Li, Chen Li, Zhengrui Li, Lina Chen, Qiong Lu
pmc-13130571.description: Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs), the DNA-protein structures released by neutrophils within the tumor microenvironment (TME), play a role in cancer that extends far beyond their traditional antimicrobial function. Specifically, NETs exert multifaceted and context-dependent effects on tumor progression, metastasis, immune regulation, and therapeutic response, showing their robust activity in shaping the complex landscape of tumor biology.

pmc-13209299.title: Nutrition Support for Children with Paediatric Intestinal Pseudo-Obstruction (PIPO) in the United Kingdom—An Explorative Survey by the British Society of Paediatric Gastroenterology, Hepatology and Nutrition (BSPGHAN)
pmc-13209299.creator: Alessandra Mari, Keith James Lindley, Sally Buxton, Sian Kirkham, Jutta Kӧglmeier
pmc-13209299.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Background/Objectives: Paediatric intestinal pseudo-obstruction (PIPO) is a disorder of gut motility in childhood, frequently leading to intestinal failure (IF). Consensus on optimum nutrition management (oral, enteral, intravenous feeding exclusively or in combination) is lacking. Our aim was to investigate the current approach to the nutrition support of children (<18 years) with PIPO managed in Gastroenterology centres in the United Kingdom (UK) and long-term mode of feeding.

pmc-13331967.title: Real-world implementation of electronic patient-reported outcome measures (ePROMs) in routine oncology practice: a scoping review
pmc-13331967.creator: K. Liao, Q. Liu, Y. Wang, K.H. Law, N. Takemura, D.H.Z. Lui, Y.-K. Lo, C. Faivre-Finn, T. Nuamek, J. Price, K.Y. Ho, J. Yorke
pmc-13331967.description: BackgroundRoutine collection of electronic patient-reported outcome measures (ePROMs) enhances symptom monitoring and improves outcomes in cancer care. We evaluated published reports of real-world ePROM implementation in oncology, focusing on approaches to implementation, types of ePROMs used, completion rates, factors associated with ePROM completion, and impacts on patient and health care process/system-level outcomes.

pmc-13396887.title: High IL‐10 levels during CRS are negatively associated with NK‐cell recovery after CAR‐T cell therapy
pmc-13396887.creator: Xindi Wang, Wenjing Luo, Yingying Li, Jianghua Wu, Lu Tang, Chenggong Li, Qiaolin Liu, Zhihan Chen, Yu Hu, Heng Mei

pmc-13662876.title: Deep learning–based quantification of muscle volume and attenuation and their associations with preinjury ambulatory status in patients with hip fractures
pmc-13662876.creator: Tomoki Asano, Keisuke Uemura, Sotaro Kono, Ryo Higuchi, Yi Gu, Hirokazu Mae, Tetsuro Tani, Kazuma Takashima, Tatsuhiko Kutsuna, Yoshito Otake, Masaki Takao, Seiji Okada, Hidetoshi Hamada
pmc-13662876.description: ObjectivesUse a deep learning model on computerized tomography images to explore how muscle volume and attenuation relate to preinjury ambulatory levels in patients with intertrochanteric or femoral neck fractures.MethodsThis retrospective study involved 170 female patients with intertrochanteric or femoral neck fractures who had preoperative hip computed tomography (CT) scans.

pmc-13689093.title: New purple sulfur bacteria genomes from Nebraska salt marsh enrichments
pmc-13689093.creator: Maria F. Orta Medellin, Evelyne Y. Aguirre Zepeda, Genesis Gallegos Martinez, John A. Kyndt
pmc-13689093.description: Two genomes from a Winogradsky column enrichment from the Nebraska salt marshes were sequenced. The analysis of whole-genome phylogeny and average nucleotide identity comparisons indicated that these belong to species of purple sulfur bacteria, Halochromatium and Ectothiorhodospira marina, that have not been described before.
